summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and Tuple[ControlType, str] to the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" format entry and Control.title(title) classmethod with docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title) once per control; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) returning True when written and False when not a terminal, with no Windows calls and the required docstring; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: console test (forced terminal, skipped on win32), control test for Control.title("hello"), and a Windows-only renderer test asserting set_title called once with "Hello, world!". Not run, per instructions: tests, Black, and any repository code. Not committed. Added lines are under 88 characters; some pre-existing lines in tests/test_console.py exceed that.
